title: Sr. Organization Development Executive
description_text:
## Job Description
Are you a visionary HR professional passionate about shaping dynamic workplaces and driving organizational excellence? We are seeking an exceptional Sr. Organization Development Executive to join our vibrant team. This is an incredible on-site opportunity to lead transformative initiatives and leave a lasting impact on our company's success! Overview: As our Sr. Organization Development Executive, you will be responsible for designing and implementing strategies that enhance our organizational effectiveness. You will be instrumental in cultivating a thriving culture, optimizing structures, and ensuring our people are empowered to achieve their full potential. This role is perfect for an experienced professional ready to make a significant difference. Responsibilities: Strategically develop and implement robust Organization Culture initiatives that foster engagement, collaboration, and high performance. Design, evaluate, and optimize Organization Structure to align with strategic goals and enhance operational efficiency. Develop and refine comprehensive Job Descriptions (JDs) , ensuring clarity, accuracy, and alignment with organizational needs. Establish and monitor Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) across various departments to drive accountability and measure success. Analyze and streamline Workflows to improve productivity, reduce bottlenecks, and enhance overall operational effectiveness. Manage and enhance Performance Management Systems (PMS) , ensuring fair, consistent, and effective performance evaluation and development. Lead change management efforts, guiding the organization through transitions with clear communication and strategic support. Collaborate with leadership to identify organizational development needs and implement innovative solutions. Fostering a culture of continuous learning and development. Skills & Technologies: This role demands expertise in Organization Culture development, Organization Structure optimization, Job Description (JD) creation, KPI implementation, Workflow analysis, and Performance Management Systems (PMS) management, Succession Planning . Strong capabilities in talent management, change management, and HR strategy are essential. Impact: Your work will directly impact employee engagement, operational efficiency, and overall business performance, making you a key driver of our continued success and growth.

## Job Requirements
Experience & Expertise: We're seeking an experienced professional with 3-5 years of dedicated experience in Organization Development or a related Human Resources field. Core Competencies: Proven expertise in developing and nurturing Organization Culture . Hands-on experience with all related functions . Exceptional skills in Talent Management and Change Management . A strategic mindset with a solid understanding of HR Strategy and Organizational Development principles. Excellent Communication Skills , both written and verbal, to influence stakeholders at all levels. Superior Analytical Skills and a proactive approach to Problem Solving . Career Level: This is an Experienced level role, perfect for someone ready to take on significant responsibility and lead impactful initiatives.

title: Business Development Manager
description_text:
## Job Description
Are you a dynamic and results-driven professional with a passion for forging strong relationships and expanding market presence? We are actively seeking an exceptional Business Development Manager to join our remote team in Sharjah, United Arab Emirates! This is an incredible opportunity to drive growth, especially within the vital Chinese market, and lead our marketing initiatives for the MENA region. If you thrive on building connections, exceeding targets, and making a tangible impact, this role is for you! Overview: As our Business Development Manager, you will be at the forefront of our growth strategy, responsible for acquiring new clients, with a particular focus on the Chinese market. You'll also be instrumental in executing marketing activities across the MENA region, ensuring our brand resonates with key audiences. Your success will directly impact our expansion and market penetration. Responsibilities: Proactively acquire new clients , targeting especially Chinese companies, and expanding our client portfolio. Develop and execute comprehensive marketing activities tailored for the MENA region. Establish and nurture strong, lasting relationships with clients , acting as a trusted advisor. Consistently follow up on client relationships, ensuring high levels of satisfaction and engagement. Provide regular weekly updates on client connections and partnership developments. Work closely with internal teams to align business development efforts with overall company objectives. Strategize and implement initiatives to enhance client loyalty and retention. Skills/Technologies: This role demands a powerful blend of strategic thinking, relationship-building prowess, and a deep understanding of market dynamics. You'll leverage your expertise in client acquisition, marketing strategy, and partnership development to achieve outstanding results. Growth Opportunities: We are committed to your professional development. As you excel in this role, you will have ample opportunities to take on greater responsibilities, lead new initiatives, and shape the future of our market presence. Your achievements will be recognized and rewarded, with a bonus and commission structure directly tied to client performance. Team/Culture: Join a vibrant, supportive, and results-oriented remote team that values collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement. We foster an environment where your contributions are celebrated, and your professional growth is a priority. Impact: Your efforts will be pivotal in expanding our client base, strengthening our market position in the MENA region, and driving significant revenue growth. You will be a key player in our success story, directly influencing our strategic direction and market reach.

## Job Requirements
Experience: We are seeking an Experienced professional with 3-7 years of proven success in business development, sales, or a related field. Required Skills: Demonstrable expertise in Business Development , particularly in client acquisition and retention. Strong background in Marketing , with experience in developing and executing regional marketing campaigns. Exceptional Sales acumen, with a track record of exceeding targets. Experience in Public Relations (PR) and brand building. Proficiency in Analysis to identify market opportunities and inform strategies. Proven ability to acquire clients , especially within international markets like China. Outstanding Relationship Management skills, capable of building and maintaining strong client bonds. A track record of successful Partnership Development . Excellent Communication and interpersonal skills, essential for weekly updates and client interactions. Automotive Industry Knowledge is highly preferred, demonstrating an understanding of the sector's nuances. Career Level Expectations: This role is designed for an experienced professional ready to take on significant responsibility and drive impactful results from day one. You are a self-starter who thrives in a remote environment and is committed to continuous growth.

Support visual merchandising and in-store branding initiatives. Manage corporate gifting programs, including end-of-year gifts for banks, VIP clients, and institutional partners. Territory & Business Expansion Identify opportunities for new boutique openings and business growth. Search and evaluate potential boutique and office locations within the territory. Continuously improve store performance, customer experience, and operational efficiency.

2.1 Custom Development • Design, build, and maintain custom Odoo modules using Python and Odoo's ORM framework • Extend or override existing Odoo modules using inheritance patterns (classical, prototype, delegation) • Develop custom reports using QWeb (PDF and HTML) and configure BI views and dashboards • Build automated actions, scheduled jobs (cron), and server-side business logic • Implement custom wizards, transient models, and multi-step workflows 2.2 Integration and API Development • Design and implement REST API integrations between Odoo and external systems (MES, logistics platforms, third-party services) • Use Odoo's XML-RPC and JSON-RPC interfaces for external connectivity • Develop and maintain integration with Egypt Tax Authority (ETA) e-invoicing APIs • Build webhook handlers and event-driven automation where required • Ensure data integrity and error handling in all integration workflows 2.3 Technical Configuration and Maintenance • Manage Odoo server configuration, module upgrades, and version migrations • Maintain and optimize PostgreSQL database performance, including query analysis and indexing • Write and maintain deployment scripts, Docker configurations, and CI/CD pipelines where applicable • Conduct code reviews and ensure adherence to Odoo community coding standards • Support UAT by resolving technical defects and regression issues 2.4 Documentation and Communication • Produce clear technical specifications, module documentation, and integration guides written in English • Communicate technical constraints and trade-offs clearly to non-technical stakeholders • Maintain a change log and versioning discipline for all custom code in Git • Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and technical review sessions 3. Required Qualifications and Experience 3.1 Technical Skills • Minimum 3 years of hands-on Odoo development experience (versions 16 through 19 preferred) • Strong Python proficiency: OOP, decorators, generators, async patterns, and clean code practices • Deep knowledge of Odoo ORM: models, fields, recordsets, constraints, [removed], compute, depends • Experience with Odoo 19 framework changes and new API patterns is a strong advantage • Solid understanding of PostgreSQL: schema design, query optimization, and raw SQL when needed • Proficiency in Odoo frontend technologies: OWL (Odoo Web Library), JavaScript ES6+, XML QWeb templates • Experience with Git version control and branching strategies (GitFlow or similar) • Familiarity with Linux server administration (Ubuntu), Docker, and basic DevOps practices • Understanding of REST API design principles and experience with external API integrations • Knowledge of ETA e-invoicing technical specifications is a significant advantage

## Job Requirements

All technical documentation, code comments, commit messages, and formal communications must be in English • Spoken English proficiency sufficient for clear participation in technical meetings and stakeholder discussions • Arabic (Egyptian dialect) is a strong advantage for internal team communication

title: Senior Business Development Manager (AI & Robotics) – EMEA, Remote
description_text:
## Job Description
About Pokamind Pokamind is an early-stage startup working at the intersection of AI and robotics. We're a small team building real products, not slide decks, and we're now at the point where we need someone who can go out and open doors for us across the EMEA region. You won't be handed a playbook and a warm pipeline. You'll help us build both. The role We're looking for a senior business developer who genuinely gets excited about AI and robotics and can translate that into real conversations with real people. Because we're a startup, the job is deliberately broad. On any given week you might be mapping out a market, writing outreach that doesn't sound like everyone else's, sitting on a call with a potential partner, or feeding what you hear back to the product team so we build the right thing. Concretely, you'll be: Finding and qualifying potential clients and partners across EMEA, and figuring out which ones are actually worth our time. Owning outreach end to end, from the first message to the signed agreement, including the marketing and positioning work that makes that outreach land. Building and nurturing partnerships, especially with people and organisations you already know or can reach through your network in the region. Negotiating and closing deals, then staying close enough to keep those relationships healthy. Working shoulder to shoulder with the founders on strategy, pricing, and where we point the company next. The role is fully remote. We care about what you deliver, not which chair you sit in. Who we think will do well here Honestly, the network matters. If you already have real relationships across EMEA in AI, robotics, industrial, or adjacent tech spaces, that's a huge part of what we're hiring for. Beyond that, we're looking for someone comfortable with the ambiguity of a startup, who can run without a manager standing over them, and who's just as happy writing a cold email as they are in a boardroom. If you've been the person who built a function from scratch before, you'll feel at home. What we offer A genuine seat at the table and real ownership of the commercial side of the business. The freedom to work how and where you work best. And the rare chance to shape a company in AI and robotics while it's still small enough that your decisions actually move the needle. If this sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you, and we're especially interested in the specific EMEA relationships you'd bring with you.

## Job Requirements
6+ years in business development, sales, or partnerships, ideally some of it in a startup or early-stage environment. A real, active network across the EMEA region that you can put to work from day one. Genuine interest in AI and robotics, enough to hold your own in a technical conversation and speak credibly to prospects. A track record of finding, opening, and closing deals on your own, not just managing an inherited pipeline. Comfort wearing several hats: outreach, marketing, partnerships, negotiation, and market research. Strong written and spoken English; other EMEA languages are a real plus. Self-starter mindset. You're organised, you follow through, and you don't need to be managed closely. Happy working fully remote and across different time zones.

title: Data Protection Officer(DPO)
description_text:
## Job Description
Ensure organization-wide compliance with PDPL No. 151 of 2020, its Executive Regulations, and PDPC decisions, circulars, and licensing conditions. Establish, maintain, and periodically review the personal data protection framework, including policies, standards, and procedures covering collection, processing, storage, disclosure, and destruction of personal data. Maintain a comprehensive and up-to-date Record of Processing Activities (RoPA) describing all personal data processing operations, legal bases, retention periods, and security measures. Manage the organization's licenses, permits, and accreditations required from the PDPC, including those for processing sensitive personal data, electronic marketing, and cross-border data transfers. Verify the validity and lawfulness of data processing systems and conduct periodic evaluations and audits of their effectiveness, documenting and reporting the results. Establish and operate procedures for receiving, verifying, and responding to data subject requests (access, correction, erasure, objection, withdrawal of consent) within the timelines prescribed by the PDPL and its Executive Regulations. Ensure that valid, informed, and documented consent is obtained where required as the legal basis for processing, and that consent withdrawal mechanisms are available. Handle and resolve complaints submitted by data subjects and maintain a register of complaints and their outcomes. Act as the official liaison and point of contact with the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Centre, including registration, correspondence, inspections, and requests for information. Deliver ongoing data protection training and awareness programs for employees and management. Report periodically to executive management and relevant governance committees on the organization's data protection posture, compliance gaps, incidents, and remediation plans. Monitor legal and regulatory developments (PDPL Executive Regulations, PDPC guidance, sectoral requirements from CBE, NTRA, FRA, etc.) and advise on their impact.

## Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Law, Information Security, Computer Science, or a related field; a postgraduate qualification in data protection, cybersecurity, or compliance is an advantage. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in data protection, privacy compliance, information security governance, or regulatory compliance, with at least 2 years in a privacy-focused role. Demonstrable knowledge of Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law No. 151 of 2020 and its Executive Regulations, and familiarity with international frameworks such as the EU GDPR for benchmarking purposes. Experience dealing with regulators; prior interaction with Egyptian regulatory bodies is a strong advantage. Recognized privacy/security certifications preferred: CIPP/E, CIPM, CIPT (IAPP), CDPSE (ISACA), CISM, CISSP, or ISO/IEC 27701 Lead Implementer. Fluency in Arabic and English (written and spoken) is required, given bilingual regulatory correspondence and documentation.

description_text:
## Job Description
Job Purpose To lead, oversee, and guarantee organizational compliance with the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Law (PDPL - Law No. 151 of 2020), serving as the official, legally recognized liaison between the company, the Egyptian Personal Data Protection Center (PDPC), and data subjects (primarily focusing on employee and family records). Key Responsibilities 1. Compliance & Technical Oversight ROPA Management: Develop and maintain the Record of Processing Activities (ROPA) for digital and physical employee records. Risk Assessment: Review and advise on Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs) and Legitimate Interest Assessments (LIAs). Safeguards & Training: Advise technical teams on access controls, audit trails, and data breach prevention safeguards, while driving staff privacy training. 2. Regulatory & Data Subject Relations PDPC Liaison: Act as the registered, sole point of contact for the PDPC during audits and inquiries. Breach & Reporting: Manage and report data breaches to the PDPC within statutory deadlines, and submit mandated annual compliance reports. Rights Resolution: Maintain secure channels to receive and resolve employee data subject requests and complaints within legal timeframes.

## Job Requirements
• Accreditation : Must pass the PDPC Lead DPO Exam with a score above 80%. • Official Registry : Active registration in the PDPC DPO Registry with a valid "DPO Code". • Education : University degree (preferably in Law, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or Business). • Experience : 3 to 5 years of proven experience in data privacy, cybersecurity, compliance, or corporate governance (senior executive or consultant background preferred). • Certifications ( Preferred ): Recognized credentials (e.g., IAPP, ISC2, PECB, or equivalent ISO certifications).

title: Sales Account Executive
description_text:
## Job Description
Are you a driven sales professional ready to make a significant impact? We are seeking a dynamic and results-oriented Sales Account Executive to join our vibrant team in Cairo, Egypt . This is an exciting on-site opportunity for an experienced individual eager to excel in a fast-paced environment and contribute directly to our growth! Overview As a Sales Account Executive, you will be at the forefront of our customer engagement, building lasting relationships and driving revenue. You'll be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, managing client accounts, and ensuring an exceptional customer experience from start to finish. If you thrive on connecting with people and achieving ambitious targets, this role is for you! Responsibilities Proactively identify and pursue new sales opportunities through various channels, including telesales and direct outreach. Build and nurture strong relationships with prospective and existing clients, understanding their needs and positioning our solutions effectively. Conduct compelling presentations and product demonstrations , showcasing the value and benefits of our offerings. Negotiate contracts and close sales , consistently meeting and exceeding individual and team sales targets. Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records using CRM software, ensuring seamless follow-up and account management. Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure client satisfaction and successful service delivery. Stay informed about industry trends , market conditions, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities. Skills & Technologies This role demands a blend of strong interpersonal abilities and a strategic sales mindset. You will leverage your expertise in Customer Service , Sales , and Telesales , combined with excellent Communication Skills and Active Listening . Proficiency with CRM Software is essential for managing your pipeline and client interactions. Your adeptness in Negotiation , Problem-Solving , and Time Management will be critical for success. A solid foundation in Product Knowledge and unwavering Resilience will empower you to overcome challenges and consistently achieve your goals. Growth Opportunities We are committed to the professional development of our team members. As an Experienced Sales Account Executive, you will have ample opportunities to refine your sales strategies, expand your market knowledge, and take on increased responsibilities. We provide a clear path for career advancement within our sales organization, encouraging continuous learning and skill enhancement. Team & Culture Join a supportive and high-energy sales team dedicated to collective success. We foster a collaborative culture where innovation is encouraged, and achievements are celebrated. You'll be part of a group that values mentorship, shared learning, and a passion for delivering outstanding results to our customers. Impact Your contributions as a Sales Account Executive will directly influence our company's growth and market presence in Cairo. You will be instrumental in expanding our client base, strengthening customer relationships, and driving revenue, playing a vital role in our continued success and reputation.

## Responsibilities
Proactively identify and pursue new sales opportunities through various channels, including telesales and direct outreach. Build and nurture strong relationships with prospective and existing clients, understanding their needs and positioning our solutions effectively. Conduct compelling presentations and product demonstrations , showcasing the value and benefits of our offerings. Negotiate contracts and close sales , consistently meeting and exceeding individual and team sales targets. Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records using CRM software, ensuring seamless follow-up and account management. Collaborate closely with internal teams to ensure client satisfaction and successful service delivery. Stay informed about industry trends , market conditions, and competitor activities to identify new opportunities.

## Job Requirements
Experience that Excites: Possess 1-3 years of proven sales experience in a dynamic environment, demonstrating a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. A Skillset for Success: Exceptional Customer Service and Sales acumen. Proven expertise in Telesales and lead generation. Outstanding Communication Skills , both verbal and written, with a talent for Active Listening . Strong Negotiation abilities and a knack for closing deals. Proficiency with CRM Software for efficient client management. Excellent Problem-Solving capabilities and strategic thinking. Superior Time Management and organizational skills. Demonstrated ability to acquire and apply strong Product Knowledge . Unwavering Resilience and a positive, persistent attitude. Adept at Relationship Building and fostering client loyalty. Ability to perform Market Analysis to identify trends and opportunities. Career Level: This role is perfectly suited for an Experienced professional ready to take on significant responsibilities and drive impactful results. Location: Must be able to work on-site in Cairo, Egypt .

title: Software QA Tester
description_text:
## Job Description
Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans and test cases for ERP modules and e-commerce features. Perform functional, regression, integration, and user acceptance testing (UAT) across web and backend systems. Identify, document, and track software defects using bug-tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Azure DevOps, Bugzilla). Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners to understand requirements and acceptance criteria. Validate end-to-end business workflows in ERP systems (e.g., order management, inventory, procurement, financials). Test e-commerce platform functionality including product catalog, shopping cart, checkout flow, payment gateways, and order fulfillment. Conduct API testing using tools such as Postman or SoapUI. Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives in an Agile/Scrum environment. Create and maintain detailed test documentation including test strategies, test results, and QA reports. Test mobile applications on iOS and Android platforms, covering functional, UI/UX, and compatibility testing across various devices and OS versions. Perform mobile-specific testing including push notifications, offline behavior, deep linking, gestures, and app performance. Support performance and load testing activities and analyze results. Ensure compliance with internal quality standards and best practices.

## Job Requirements
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum 3 years of proven experience in software quality assurance and testing. Hands-on experience testing ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle ERP, Microsoft Dynamics, Odoo, or similar). Solid experience testing e-commerce platforms (e.g., Magento, Shopify, WooCommerce, custom-built platforms). Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). Proficiency in writing clear, concise, and comprehensive test cases and bug reports. Experience testing mobile applications on both iOS and Android, including testing on real devices and simulators/emulators. Good working knowledge of SQL for data validation and backend testing. Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies. Preferred Qualifications: Familiarity with device farms such as BrowserStack or AWS Device Farm for cross-device testing. ISTQB Foundation or Advanced Level certification is a plus. Experience with performance testing tools such as JMeter or k6. Understanding of REST/SOAP APIs and experience with API testing tools. Knowledge of e-commerce business processes including inventory, pricing, promotions, and logistics.

title: Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist (Software & Engineering)
description_text:
## Job Description
OYA Energy is expanding into Digital Engineering & Industrial Technology Solutions, supporting regional projects in digital transformation, industrial automation, infrastructure, utilities, and technical engineering services across Egypt and the Gulf region. We are seeking a highly proactive Technical Talent Acquisition Specialist to build and scale our software and engineering teams. Job Overview The selected candidate will be responsible for establishing and managing a strong recruitment pipeline for software developers, technical engineers, QA specialists, industrial digitalization professionals, and related technical roles. This role requires someone capable of building a high-quality talent pool from scratch, conducting sourcing activities, screening candidates, coordinating interviews, and supporting organizational growth. Key Responsibilities Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline for technical and software-related positions . Source candidates, Screen and shortlist candidates for technical positions. Coordinate technical interviews with department heads. Build recruitment databases and maintain candidate pools. Support employer branding for Oya Energy Digital Engineering. Assist in designing hiring processes and onboarding procedures. Coordinate hiring for Egypt and Gulf-oriented technical projects. Hiring Focus Areas Candidates sourcing experience in: Full Stack Developers (.NET / Angular) Backend Developers Frontend Developers QA Engineers Data & BI Engineers Technical Coordinators / Business Analysts

## Job Requirements
Requirements 2–4 years experience in Technical Recruitment or Talent Acquisition. Previous experience hiring software engineers is highly preferred. title: Senior - Staff IOS Native Software Engineer
description_text:
## Job Description
About ExpiWell ExpiWell is a mobile platform built for experience sampling and ecological momentary assessment (EMA) research. We help researchers and clinicians collect real-time data from participants in their daily lives through intuitive mobile experiences and survey tools. About the Role We are seeking a Senior / Staff iOS Native Software Engineer to own the technical direction, system design, and long-term evolution of the ExpiWell mobile ecosystem. This is a high-level engineering role requiring deep, battle-tested expertise in native Apple ecosystems. This is not a generalist web or frontend JavaScript role. Our core platform is a native iOS application, and your foundational engineering strength must be rooted deeply in native Apple frameworks. However, because we are driving our transition toward a unified mobile platform, architectural experience with React Native and the JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystem is a strict requirement. You will be the bridge that ensures our native infrastructure integrates seamlessly with our cross-platform future while adhering to rigorous clinical data standards. Our Current Codebase & Tech Stack To give you an exact picture of what you will be stepping into, our repository and architecture primarily center around: Swift: Modern native core implementation, native modules, and platform architecture. Apple Frameworks & Kits: Deep application of HealthKit , SensorKit , CoreLocation , and CoreMotion for participant telemetry and health metrics collection. JavaScript / TypeScript: React Native expansion for shared business logic and cross-platform feature parity. What You'll Do Architectural Leadership: Own the overarching architecture, design patterns, and technical roadmap for our production iOS (Swift) and React Native applications. Biometric & Biomechanic Telemetry: Design and optimize data collection services that query and process passive/active research metrics using HealthKit and SensorKit . Core Mobile Telemetry: Optimize hardware-level native services including location monitoring ( CoreLocation ) and motion processing frameworks ( CoreMotion ) for geofencing and location-based survey triggers. Data Strategy & Privacy: Architect bulletproof offline-first data persistence layers using CoreData and Secure Keychain, adhering strictly to global compliance baselines ( HIPAA , GDPR , and SOC 2 ). Bridge Architecture: Write high-performance native bridging modules to connect native iOS Swift logic with our React Native and JavaScript/TypeScript ecosystems. Legacy Modernization: Strategize and execute the incremental refactoring, modularization, and modernization of our legacy native codebases without interrupting active clinical research studies. Release & Infrastructure Ownership: Direct the entire App Store submission pipeline, provisioning profiles, CocoaPods dependency management, and automated Xcode deployment infrastructure. Required Qualifications Expert-Level Native iOS Mastery: Deep professional experience in native iOS application development with a proven track record operating at a Senior, Lead, or Staff level. Framework Expertise: Complete mastery of UIKit, Storyboards, Auto Layout, CoreLocation, CoreData, HealthKit, and SensorKit . Compliance & Security Rigor: Solid understanding of building apps that strictly comply with HIPAA, GDPR, and SOC 2 Type 2 guidelines (end-to-end encryption at rest and in transit, access control enforcement, and audit logs). Cross-Platform Competency: Production-grade architecture experience using JavaScript/TypeScript and React Native to build cross-platform feature parity. Language Proficiency: Advanced command of Swift and modern native iOS architectures. App Store Pedigree: Complete history of deploying, configuring, and maintaining highly rated commercial apps directly on the Apple App Store. Why ExpiWell Drive the technical vision for technology used globally in critical behavioral and health research. Collaborative, research-driven engineering team environment with high technical autonomy. Flexible, fully remote working structure within Bangladesh. Competitive monthly salary package aligned with the absolute top tier of local senior standards. Opportunity to serve as the ultimate technical authority and shape our mobile architecture. Job Type: Full-time Work Location: Remote

## Job Requirements
Preferred Qualifications Experience designing flexible engines for complex dynamic forms, custom survey validation logic, or matrix questions. Engineering background in health-tech, remote patient monitoring (RPM), or data-intensive research applications. Experience building and scaling custom automated build pipelines (Fastlane, Xcode Cloud). Understanding of broader cross-platform ecosystems, including Android execution environments. Core Tech Stack (iOS Native First) Primary Native Language: Swift Location & Contextual Tracking: CoreLocation, Geolocation, Geofencing, CoreMotion Push Notifications & Cloud Integration: Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM Notifications) Native Apple Frameworks & Kits: HealthKit, SensorKit, CoreData, UIKit, Storyboards, Auto Layout, Secure Keychain Cross-Platform Integration (Bridge): React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript (used strictly for shared business logic and cross-platform feature parity) Compliance, Security & Vulnerability Management: Security Pentesting, HIPAA, GDPR, SOC 2 Type 2 compliant data pipelines and encrypted local storage Dependency Management & DevOps: Swift Package Manager (SPM), CocoaPods, Fastlane, Xcode Cloud

title: QA / Software Test Engineer (AI-Augmented Testing)
description_text:
## Job Description
We're looking for a Software Test Engineer with around 2 years of experience who combines solid testing fundamentals with curiosity about using AI to make testing faster and more reliable. You'll help ensure the quality of our products by designing and running tests, building automation, and applying AI tools to generate tests, analyze failures, and cut down on manual effort. This is a great fit for someone early in their QA career who wants to grow while working with modern, AI-assisted testing practices. What You'll Do - Write and maintain test cases and automated tests across web, API, and/or mobile. - Use AI-assisted tools to help generate test cases, create test data, and expand coverage from user stories or requirements. - Build and maintain automated tests (UI, API, regression) and help keep them running in CI/CD pipelines. - Use AI to speed up failure triage — grouping similar failures and flagging flaky tests. - Work with self-healing automation and AI-driven locators to reduce test maintenance. - Perform functional, regression, and exploratory testing. - Review AI-generated tests and output critically — checking correctness and removing noise rather than trusting it blindly. - Track, document, and clearly report bugs, and work with developers to get them resolved. - Learn and experiment with new AI testing tools, and share what works with the team.

## Job Requirements
- Around 2 years (roughly 1–3) of experience in software testing or QA. - Good understanding of testing fundamentals: test case design, regression, the test pyramid, and the bug life cycle. - Experience writing automated tests with a framework such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or Appium. - Basic-to-intermediate scripting ability in at least one language (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, Java, or C#). - Some hands-on experience using AI tools in a development or testing workflow (e.g., LLM-based assistants or AI test generators) — or clear enthusiasm to learn. - Experience testing APIs (REST) with a tool like Postman. - Familiarity with version control (Git) and basic CI/CD concepts. - Attention to detail and the judgment to question results — including AI output that looks wrong. - Clear written and verbal communication. Nice to Have - Exposure to AI-powered or self-healing testing platforms. - Some prompt engineering experience for generating tests, test data, or documentation. - Basic knowledge of performance testing (JMeter, k6) or security testing. - Curiosity about testing AI/ML features (validating model outputs, prompt regression, hallucination or safety checks). - Familiarity with Docker or cloud test environments. - ISTQB Foundation (or similar) certification. How We Use AI in Testing (so you know what to expect) - *Test generation:* turning requirements and code into draft test cases and data. - *Maintenance:* self-healing locators and AI suggestions to cut down on broken tests. - *Analysis:* automatic failure grouping, flaky-test detection, and prioritizing what to fix first. - *Productivity:* AI assistants for writing scripts, documentation, and bug reports — always with human review. We treat AI as a helper, not a replacement for engineering judgment. You'll always be expected to check and own the quality of what ships. What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months) - Ramped up on our products, test suites, and CI/CD pipeline. - Contributing reliable automated tests and helping reduce manual regression effort. - Using AI tools to speed up test creation or failure triage in a measurable way. - Working well with developers to help ship high-quality releases.

title: AI-Native Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description_text:
## Job Description
We're building a team of engineers working at the frontier of AI-assisted software development. Whatever your backend stack — Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PHP, .NET / C#, Java, or Go — if you already build real products with AI in the loop, we would appreciate the opportunity to speak with you. Our customers are moving fast to embed AI into their products and into the way they build software, using agentic tools to take work from idea to production. What matters is solid engineering craft, real experience using AI agentically to ship code, and a readiness to grow into new technologies where the work needs it. Please note: this is a hands-on software engineering role — you’ll be building and shipping AI-augmented features. It is not a Data Science, Machine Learning research, or model-training position. If your focus is statistics, model training, or data analysis rather than building software, this role isn’t the right fit. Responsibilities Build and ship full-stack web applications and AI-powered product features, from early idea to production release. Use modern AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, and Cursor as part of your daily engineering workflow — for research, prototyping, code generation, refactoring, testing, debugging, and documentation. Integrate AI capabilities into real products, including LLM APIs, retrieval-based systems, RAG, and agent/tool workflows. Review AI-generated code critically. Make sure it is reliable, maintainable, secure, and consistent with the team’s engineering standards. Take part in architecture discussions, technical design, and code reviews. Help define reusable patterns and practical team practices for working with AI. Work closely with engineering, product, delivery, and customer-facing teams. Understand not only what needs to be built, but also why it matters for the business. Stay flexible with the stack. Strengthen your backend expertise while growing into frontend and cloud areas when the project requires it. What we offer Stable long-term cooperation and competitive compensation. The chance to work at the cutting edge of agentic AI development on international projects. A fast and well-structured onboarding process with a dedicated mentor. A clear career development path and access to learning programs. Paid vacation, national public holidays, and support during religious celebrations. A modern and comfortable office based in Smart Village, at the heart of Cairo’s tech ecosystem. Healthy work–life balance. A welcoming corporate culture, team support, and respectful communication.

## Job Requirements
What we expect from you 3+ years of professional software engineering experience, building web/product applications. Strong command of at least one backend language: Node.js, TypeScript, Python, PHP, Go, .NET / C#, or Java . Solid full-stack fundamentals — comfortable working across APIs, databases, and deployment, not just a single layer. Hands-on experience using AI-assisted / agentic engineering tools in real delivery work (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Copilot CLI, or similar). We mean confident, fluent use — these tools are already a routine part of how you build and ship, not something you’ve only tried a few times. Demonstrable experience with several of: prompt engineering for development workflows, multi-step agentic development, AI-assisted debugging and refactoring, AI-assisted test generation, and rapid prototyping with AI. The judgment to use AI responsibly — understanding the limitations, risks, and governance considerations of AI-generated code. A genuine readiness to learn and work in the front-end (any modern framework) when the work calls for it. Front-end experience is not required, but the right mindset is. Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently and drive work to production with little supervision. Upper-Intermediate English level (B2). A proactive mindset, good communication, and the ability to thrive in a high-impact, fast-paced environment. Will be a plus Front-end experience with a modern framework (React / Angular / Vue) and TypeScript. Cloud fundamentals with one of the major platforms (AWS / Azure / GCP). Experience with CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and Kubernetes. Knowledge of message brokers (Kafka / RabbitMQ) and observability (ELK / Prometheus & Grafana). Experience embedding AI/LLM features into products: RAG pipelines, vector databases (Pinecone / Qdrant), embeddings, and semantic search. Experience building MCP servers/tools, custom “agent skills,” or multi-agent orchestration (e.g., LangChain / LangGraph). Experience running self-hosted or local models (Ollama, vLLM). Awareness of secure, governed use of AI in enterprise development environments (e.g., preventing data/PII leakage).

This is an unparalleled opportunity to drive excellence, mentor talent, and ensure our cutting-edge solutions meet the highest standards of quality. You will champion best practices, foster a culture of continuous improvement, and play a pivotal role in our product lifecycle from conception to deployment. This is a hybrid role, offering the best of both collaborative office work and the flexibility of remote contributions. Excellent Communication and interpersonal skills, capable of influencing stakeholders at all levels. Career Level: This is an Experienced level role, perfect for a seasoned professional ready to take on significant responsibility and drive innovation.

Designs and implements application components, writes clean code, and performs thorough unit testing . Analyzes complex technical problems and proposes innovative solutions. Participates in code reviews, enforces best practices, and collaborates with cross-functional teams. Contributes to architecture discussions and provides mentorship to junior engineers. Supports deployment and post-release maintenance. Brings 5 to 7 years of hands-on experience in Microsoft cloud business applications and development frameworks.

## Job Requirements
Job Requirements: Technical Requirements Strong ability to navigate and work within large existing codebases independently. Solid knowledge of software engineering best practices (SOLID principles, design patterns, clean and secure code). Deep expertise in primary technologies with hands-on experience in at least two additional technologies. Good understanding of DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines. At least one relevant technical certification. Personal & Professional Requirements Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and presentation skills, including customer interaction. Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while aligning with the team. Demonstrates accountability, ownership, and a continuous improvement mindset. Provides constructive, timely, and empathetic feedback.

title: Software Project Manager
description_text:
## Job Description
Job Summary: We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Project Manager to join our growing Digital Transformation team. In this role, you will manage and lead digital transformation and system integration projects, ensuring successful delivery of solutions that align with organizational goals. You will oversee project planning, execution, and delivery, leveraging Agile and other project management methodologies to drive efficiency and innovation. This role requires a strategic thinker who can balance technical challenges with business objectives, leading cross-functional teams while managing stakeholder expectations. Key Responsibilities: Project Planning & Execution: Lead end-to-end project management for digital transformation and system integration initiatives. Develop detailed project plans, defining project scope, timelines, resources, and deliverables. Monitor and control project progress, ensuring alignment with business goals and technology requirements. Agile Methodology: Apply Agile methodologies, such as Scrum or Kanban, to ensure rapid and efficient delivery. Conduct sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to facilitate collaboration and continuous improvement. Ensure the team adheres to Agile principles, keeping projects flexible and iterative. Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with technical teams (developers, architects, analysts) and business stakeholders (operations, marketing, sales) to gather requirements, provide status updates, and ensure all parties are aligned with project goals. Stakeholder Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders. Manage expectations, resolve issues, and communicate progress to senior management and other relevant parties. Provide regular project reports and updates, highlighting risks, roadblocks, and milestones. Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify risks and issues that could impact the project timeline, scope, or quality. Develop mitigation strategies and work with the team to implement corrective actions when necessary. Process Optimization & Continuous Improvement: Evaluate current project management practices and identify areas for improvement. Implement best practices and optimize processes for greater efficiency in digital transformation initiatives. Quality Assurance: Ensure high standards of quality and integrity in all projects deliverables. Work with QA teams to develop testing plans and ensure that digital transformation solutions are thoroughly validated before deployment. Vendor and Third-party Management: Manage relationships with external vendors and service providers, ensuring that third-party solutions are integrated smoothly and meet the project’s technical and business requirements.

## Job Requirements
Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field. Master’s degree or Project Management certification (e.g., PMP, ScrumMaster) is a plus. Experience: 3-5 years of experience in managing IT projects, particularly in Digital Transformation and Systems Integration. Proven track record of delivering projects on time and within scope, ideally in Agile environments. Experience working with cross-functional teams, integrating new digital technologies into legacy systems. Methodology: Strong understanding and experience with Agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, etc.).. Ability to adapt methodologies to suit the project and team needs, driving continuous delivery and improvement. Technical Skills: Experience with tools such as Jira, Trello, Microsoft Project, and other project management or collaboration software. Familiarity with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines is advantageous. Soft Skills: Strong leadership and team management skills. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Critical thinking, problem-solving, and the ability to make sound decisions under pressure. Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities. Certifications (Preferred but Not Required): PMP (Project Management Professional) Certified ScrumMaster (CSM) or Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) or (PMP) ITIL or other relevant IT certifications

title: Quality Assurance Engineer (IT / Software)
description_text:
## Job Description
We are looking for a detail-oriented Quality Assurance (QA) Engineer with at least 2 years of experience in both Manual and Automated Testing . The ideal candidate should have a passion for delivering high-quality software, identifying issues before they reach customers, and continuously improving the testing process. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute manual test cases. Develop and maintain automated test scripts for web and API applications. Perform functional, regression, integration, smoke, and sanity testing. Identify, document, and track software defects using bug-tracking tools. Collaborate closely with developers, product managers, and designers to ensure product quality. Validate bug fixes and perform regression testing before releases. Participate in sprint planning, requirement reviews, and daily stand-ups. Contribute to improving QA processes, automation coverage, and testing standards.

## Job Requirements
Requirements Minimum 2 years of professional experience in Software Quality Assurance. Strong experience in Manual Testing . Hands-on experience with Automation Testing using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or similar. Experience testing REST APIs using Postman or similar tools. Good understanding of Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) and Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC). Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies. Experience with bug tracking tools such as Jira. Basic understanding of SQL and database validation. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent communication and documentation skills. Preferred Skills Experience with CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of Git version control. Performance or security testing experience is a plus. Experience testing logistics, e-commerce, or SaaS applications is an advantage. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience. Opportunity to work on modern, scalable products. Collaborative and growth-focused engineering culture. Professional development and learning opportunities. If you're passionate about quality, automation, and building reliable software, we'd love to hear from you.

title: Software Sales Specialist
description_text:
## Job Description
About Us: Simple Touch Software specializes in providing comprehensive ERP management solutions tailored for restaurants and cafes in the F&B local chains business. Our software covers all processes from raw material purchasing to inventory management, ensuring streamlined operations and enhanced efficiency for our clients. Job Description: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Senior Software Sales Representative to join our team. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in software sales, specifically within the F&B industry, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets. As a Senior Software Sales Representative, you will be responsible for driving sales, building and maintaining client relationships, and identifying new business opportunities. Responsibilities: Sales Strategy Development : Develop and execute strategic sales plans to achieve company sales targets and expand our customer base. This includes setting short-term and long-term goals, identifying key market segments, and creating targeted approaches for each segment. Lead Generation : Identify and qualify new business opportunities through various channels including cold calling, networking, referrals, and participation in industry events and trade shows. Client Engagement : Conduct product demonstrations and presentations to prospective clients, showcasing the features and benefits of Simple Touch Software. This involves understanding client needs, tailoring presentations to address specific pain points, and effectively communicating the value proposition. Relationship Management : Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships by understanding their needs and providing tailored solutions. Act as the primary point of contact for key clients, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty. Collaboration : Work closely with the marketing team to develop and execute promotional campaigns and with the product development team to provide customer feedback and influence product enhancements. Ensure alignment in sales strategies and product offerings to meet market demands. Sales Negotiation : Negotiate and close sales agreements, ensuring mutually beneficial terms for both the client and Simple Touch Software. Manage contract negotiations, pricing discussions, and terms of service agreements. Sales Reporting : Provide accurate sales forecasts and reports to the management team. Track sales activities, pipeline status, and key performance metrics using CRM software. Market Analysis : Stay up-to-date with industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities. Conduct market research to identify emerging opportunities and threats. Mentorship : Mentor and guide junior sales team members, sharing best practices and providing support to help them achieve their targets.

## Job Requirements
Job Requirements: Education : Bachelor’s degree in Software, Business, Marketing, or a related field. An MBA or equivalent advanced degree is a plus. Experience : Minimum of 5 years of experience in software sales, preferably within the F&B industry. Demonstrated success in meeting or exceeding sales targets. Technical Knowledge : Strong understanding of ERP software and its applications in the F&B industry. Familiarity with the technical aspects of software deployment and integration. Sales Skills : Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills. Ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear and compelling manner. Customer Focus : Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients at all levels. Strong customer service orientation with a commitment to customer satisfaction. Self-Motivation : Highly self-motivated with a results-driven approach. Proven ability to work independently and as part of a team. Technology Proficiency : Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Zoho CRM, Salesforce) and MS Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Ability to quickly learn new software tools and systems. Flexibility : Willingness to travel as needed to meet clients and attend industry events. What We Offer: Compensation : Competitive salary and commission structure, designed to reward high performers. Benefits : Comprehensive health insurance and benefits package, including dental and vision coverage. Professional Development : Opportunities for professional development and career growth. Access to training programs, industry conferences, and educational resources. Work Environment : Supportive and dynamic work environment with a focus on collaboration and innovation. Regular team-building activities and social events. Flexibility : Flexible work arrangements, including remote work options.
